sources.finding: Kashika explicitly assigns object status in a causal construction to the noncausal actor for intransitives, with As and SI examples. Restrictions on causee object status for some already transitive verbs do not remove their existing object.
The requested Ric is the causative operator referring to the instigating activity; it is not an implicit lexical meaning choice.
The sanadi-derived unit has dhatu status, allowing the independently licensed subsequent causal derivation.
Karmani pertains to transitive predicates; bare intransitives instead have Bhave. Here the predicate evaluated is the outer causative, not the bare dictionary root.
Causal passives are explicitly described;1025 licenses causal derivatives of intensives. Applying these together to uncommon complete forms is composition evidence.

conclusion: All112 passive inputs have an explicit outer causal operation and a source-supported object interpretation. Bare lexical intransitivity is not a defect in these current questions. No san-only passive occurs in the panel.
scope_limits: This is semantic licensing of the task construction, not exhaustive independent validation of every generated variant. Existing oracle exclusions still apply.
Do not generalize this argument to bare yaN/yaNluk or san-only Karmani recipes. Future menus need separate transitivity and semantic review.
Dictionary entries or grammar rules with independently unsupported usage still require quarantine; nonempty engine output alone never proves validity.

The inflection coordinates fix the promoted object agreement. Whether an eligible transitive causal construction promotes its retained object or an eligible causee does not introduce a different requested verb form once person and number are fixed.
